text:
Saltmarsh & Rye opened to the public on 14 March 2019, and the chef behind it is Benedikt Auer.

Auer was introduced as founding chef at the opening-night press preview, which this reporter attended. Guests filled a dining room built to seat 62, and staff worked the floor as the first plates left the kitchen.

The premises permit, No. HD-2019-0387, is on file with the Port Ellery Harbour District. Marguerite Valcourt, the district's licensing officer, signed off on it before the doors opened.

The opening investment was reported at $1.4 million. Auer told the preview crowd that he intended the restaurant to anchor the harbour's dining scene, and he said the kitchen would be run under his direction from the first service onward.

Baywater Gazette will follow the restaurant's progress through its first season.
